input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin with a public PubMed/Entrez query (including optional PubMed field tags), max_results 1-10, and caller-supplied contact_email
required_outputs: At most ten PubMed ESummary metadata rows in ESearch result order, with PMID, DOI when unique, title, first ten author names, journal, and provider publication date
Provider hit count, ordered PubMed PMID list, per-endpoint HTTP status and response hashes, retrieval timestamp, partial-summary IDs, and bounded claim ceiling
